digest.component_or_area: tickets-store CI fetch and rebar bootstrap/reconciler
propositions: A full clone of the tickets store is far more expensive than a blob:none partial clone (1.04 GiB/59s vs 68.7 MiB/14.3s), so CI checkout steps should add filter: blob:none.

When the tickets fetch fails, rebar init silently orphan-bootstraps a fresh empty store that diverges from origin/tickets, causing empty reads and non-fast-forwardable writes; it must fail closed with a non-zero exit and no orphan branch.

blob:none preserves the full commit graph so merge-base/commit-ancestry era scoping still works, but requires merge.ours.driver=true before applying the filter to avoid degrading .bridge_state merges to 3-way text merges.
derive_caused_by must return None when git blame fails on any path instead of electing a culprit from a partial path set and writing a wrong caused_by link.
Authorship resolvers resolve_event_commit and resolve_position_commit must use --no-renames and log.showSignature=false so signed commits yield a valid 40-hex SHA.
The stale .bridge_state.bak-retarget file (~33 MB) should be removed from HEAD to reduce working-tree size, before the reclaim epic strips blobs.
